reason: My Erbil agent works fine and I'm not leaving them, but a first order with nothing paid up front costs me nothing to test, and I'm in Shorja anyway so I can ask Abu Ali myself. I'd send one small order of phone accessories and compare the total and the speed with my usual agent.
objection: After the first order I have to pay up front again to a new name, and 13,000 a kilo plus 8% plus delivery adds up fast on stock I need to resell at a margin; if my agent is cheaper or faster I'm not switching.
would_change_my_mind: If the first order arrives on time and the total is clearly below what my Erbil agent charges, I would move part of my regular stock orders over.
